installed_process_checkpoint.scope: Real isolated Windows daemon processes, actual CLI exit, bad-token rejection, singleton and restrictive Job Objects. No provider or physical remote-host qualification.

open_findings.description: Late lease application reproduced with unchanged identity; independent scheduler and observed-cost margin validated by source and installed tests. Full load qualification remains in M7/M8.
Startup test now observes retained recovery worker result with bounded wait; installed restart cases passed.

Two Pi warm replacements failed BINDING_NOT_AUTHORIZED during M1 live UI campaign, without birth records; later refill succeeded automatically. Exact refusal frontier absent from receipts; not attributed to L1 without evidence.

M2e live HTTP startup waited about 2m20s for initial Pi build-identity inventory scan; stack dump confirms dependency through EmbeddedInventoryOwner.start. Separate owner claim from background initial discovery with retry and retained shutdown. M3c global rollout and second normal boot served HTTP before per-agent recovery; see m3c-ui-recovery.md.

M2e real Codex request delivered and acknowledged, but provider returned usageLimitExceeded. Pi and Claude succeeded. Full three-provider UI success cannot be claimed; no quota bypass or repeated requests.

Local contact is now refreshed only by current owner heartbeat; stale or replaced owner cannot preserve Ready. 46 source/installed cases passed (M3d), global rollout pending. Accessible ACK discrepancy did not recur in M3c; no ACK fix claimed.

M2e Pi recurrence diagnosed: three claimed openings without births had no original-owner containment path after native factory failure. Shared Core fix passed installed process tests. Joint M3c rollout automatically contained all three retained launches; Pi and Claude replied via Meta-harness. M3c then shut down gracefully in 6.46s and recovered all agents after restart, with a fresh Pi response. Initial CONFIG_ERROR subtype remains unproven. See m3c-ui-recovery.md.

M3c generation 68 process absent when UI was revisited, last access log 20:58:19 UTC, no recorded normal shutdown/traceback or matching Application Error event. Cause/initiator unproven. Logs preserved; generation 69 recovered all agents and Pi answered. Supervisor/host-lifetime qualification must distinguish host termination from runtime faults.

Generation 69: RECOVERY_PUBLICATION_DELAYED diagnostic write timed out and escalated to host containment, stranding all local agents. M3f makes transient diagnostic persistence best-effort without changing receipt/authority durability. Origin of initial writer delay unproven. Global generation 70 recovered all agents; Graph presence confirmed. Pi and Claude replied through the real Meta-harness with 1/1 ACK on generation 70. M4d2 narrows diagnostic fallback to RECOVERY_PUBLICATION_DELAYED only; other durable recovery evidence stays required.

An already-contained embedded owner has no automatic replacement while HTTP remains alive. Initial-start recovery is not post-containment supervision. Need retained producer join/resource release proof before replacement; M3f prevents the observed diagnostic trigger and stops manual recovery falsely reporting READY, but does not implement general owner replacement. Generation 69 also remained DRAINING_PENDING after normal shutdown despite zero occupied slots/active turns and no server child processes; exact PID termination was needed for deployment. Preserved stacks; no lock reset. Generation 70 later drained and exited normally for M3g rollout; automatic replacement of an already-contained owner is still unimplemented. Generation 71 reproduced containment after a transient recovery-status writer timeout. M3j prevents this escalation; general owner replacement remains open. Generation 71 later drained and exited normally for the qualified rollout.

First global M4d1 migration: Pi stayed RECOVERING until 03:03:20.844Z after host ready at 02:54:18Z. Closed-history retirement still precedes agent READY; certificates progressed 3/18/55 then readiness after first page. Move verified historical maintenance outside admission while retaining exact release/publication proofs; qualify with real retained history. CPU was saturated in one observation, not an attribution of the complete delay. M4d2 separates historical checkpoints from READY and live response publication; 50 installed tests passed. Real retained-history latency qualification remains pending. Deployed in generation 71; Pi reached READY in about 8s, but this boot reused earlier checkpoints and is not a controlled first-backfill comparison.

Agents initially displayed old RECOVERING until Refresh Agents while all three backend recovery rows were READY; subsequent view mount showed ONLINE. Existing poll pauses when document.hidden; cause not yet attributed and no frontend fix claimed. Follow-up 06:44–06:46 UTC 2026-10-17: generation 72 CONTROL_READY; Pi/Claude/Codex READY and Online in both existing Chrome tabs without reload/restart, four Pi WARM slots, renewed leases. Cause remains unproven. Follow-up 07:30–07:32 UTC again READY/Online with renewed leases and Pi 4 WARM; stale last-contact display observed but cause not proven. One delayed Pi publication did not change durable readiness.

Generation 70 Pi has four warm STARTING slots with FAILED/NONE sessions, terminal dispatch refusals (CONFLICT, possible_effect=false) and no Core receipts. Pool settlement recognizes CLOSED lease or failed Core receipt but misses pre-Core refusal. Pi UI response used fifth on-demand slot. Require exact durable no-send proof, never infer safe release from FAILED/NONE alone. Exact message matched dispatch inventory freshness refusal. M3g recognizes the terminal pre-Core refusal with no lease, stream, receipt or publication; 18 installed tests passed. Globally deployed in generation 71; old slots were reclaimed, four new warm sessions became available, a real UI call used one and its replacement restored 4/5 availability.

Generation 71 agents reached READY within about 8s, but first new warm reservations appeared about 4m46s after recovery began. Inventory worker observed in fingerprint/discovery; full interval also includes publication/backoff and is not wholly attributed to hashing. Need per-harness effective readiness and lower-cost initial discovery; do not relax inventory freshness or ownership checks. Four warm sessions and real Pi UI response eventually succeeded automatically. M3h parallel passive discovery measured 10.74-13.94s versus 21.75-21.94s serial with identical evidence. Startup readiness no longer inflates warm failure backoff (L15). Installed tests passed; global rollout and independent per-harness publication/readiness remain pending. M3h rolled out with M3j in generation 72. First UI Pi call waited 127.439s to RUNNING and completed in 137.667s; next warm call ran after 0.569s and completed in 7.060s. Initial observation/readiness latency remains unresolved.

Pool attempted four speculative starts before current inventory existed and counted admission refusals as warm failures; two rounds can grow backoff to 256s without native startup. Reproduced before fix. Await current host/agent/inventory prerequisites before warm reservation; nine all-harness regression cases and the 46-case installed campaign passed. Actual startup interval attribution remains incomplete; global rollout pending. M3h deployed with M3j generation 72; four warm sessions restored automatically. Historical ended warm sessions still count as actual failures; no manual backoff edit.

Generation 71 status write in EmbeddedAgentRecovery.fail timed out and contained the shared host, leaving all local agents recovering. M3j scopes transient renewal and recovery-status persistence failures, retains exact installed lease ACK and enforces an in-memory agent fence before dispatch. 43 campaign cases passed; generation 72 restored all agents and real Pi/Claude replies. Original writer holder and first error are not conclusively attributed; sanitized first-error logging added. General owner replacement remains L10.

M3i installed campaign: reset keep_agents=true completes before the new selected adapter observation is accepted. Immediate persistent message fails inventory_not_fresh (both idle and previously active reset cases); no configuration loss shown. Preserve automatic recovery and independent readiness without weakening freshness or requiring manual resend. Reproduce deterministically before choosing truthful reset readiness versus durable startup queue admission. The existing reset tests are retained unchanged. Fix keeps reset operation reconnecting until selected local inventory is accepted while independent dispatch is reopened. Eight existing reset cases and two deterministic isolation cases passed across the focused source runs. Joint installed qualification and real UI remain pending. Joint installed campaign passed both original regressions and both isolation tests; real UI validation pending.
